Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the Washington state patrol to provide radio services on a reimbursable basis.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to Washington state patrol communication chargesunder the Interlocal Cooperation Act; and adding a new section tochapter 43.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington state patrol shall provide law enforcement radiodispatch and communication services to any state agency with lawenforcement authority upon written request from such agency inaccordance with chapter 39.34 RCW, the Interlocal Cooperation Act. TheWashington state patrol shall charge the agency for radio dispatch andcommunication services on a costadded basis per agency. That basismay include only communications personnel and equipment costs expendedabove any appropriation provided by the legislature to the Washingtonstate patrol for communications, and only costs that are directlyattributable to the agency making the request. Charges to the agencymay not include depreciation, indirect costs, or any costs outside theWashington state patrol communications division.
